series.name: Official Electrolux IE split/inverter error table (36 codes)
series.notes: Official Electrolux Ireland support article 'AC error messages' — full 36-code E/F/H/C/L/P/U/HC table for split/inverter wall-mounted. Highest authority for Electrolux-badged codes. PK Lux Air/Active Air have no separate published table — this IE table is the Electrolux Group reference.

title.ur: Antifreeze se protection (coil par pani jamne se bachana)

meaning.en: Indoor coil is too cold; unit pauses anti-freeze logic to protect the heat exchanger.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil bahut thanda ho gaya hai; heat exchanger ki protection ke liye unit antifreeze logic rok kar ruk jata hai.

causes.en: Very low room temperature with fan too low, so the coil freezes.
causes.ur: Kamre ka temperature bahut kam aur fan ki raftaar poori na ho — isi wajah se coil par barf ban jata hai.

causes.en: Clogged air filter or blocked indoor airflow reducing heat exchange.
causes.ur: Hawa ka filter ganda hona ya indoor ki hawa ka rasta band hona.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If it persists, contact an Authorised Service Center; clean filter and check fan.
solutions.ur: Agar masla jari rahe to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein, filter saaf karein aur fan check karein.

notes.ur: Official lafz: antifreeze protection — indoor coil itna thanda ho jata hai ke unit apni cooling rok kar barf banne nahi deti.

title.ur: System mein rukaawat ya refrigerant ki leak

meaning.en: Refrigerant circuit is blocked or leaking, so pressure/flow is abnormal.
meaning.ur: Refrigerant circuit mein rukaawat ya leak hai, is liye pressure/flow abnormal hai.

causes.en: Capillary/filter drier blockage or moisture ice plug.
causes.ur: Capillary/filter drier mein rukaawat ya nam ki wajah se barf ka plug banna.

causes.en: Brazed joint or pipe leak after installation damage.
causes.ur: Installation ke baad brazed joint ya pipe mein leak.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: Contact an Authorised Service Center for leak test and repair.
solutions.ur: Leak ki check aur marammat ke liye Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

title.ur: Compressor ki discharge temperature zyada hone se protection

meaning.en: Discharge temperature exceeded the safe limit; compressor duty is cut to cool down.
meaning.ur: Discharge temperature mefooz hadd se upar chala gaya; compressor ka kaam rok kar use thanda kiya jata hai.

causes.en: Undercharged refrigerant or restricted condenser airflow.
causes.ur: Refrigerant kam hona ya condenser ki hawa mein rukaawat.

causes.en: Dirty condenser coils, high ambient, or failing discharge sensor.
causes.ur: Gande condenser coil, zyada ambient temperature, ya kharab discharge sensor.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

notes.en: Portable E4 has a different meaning (display↔main PCB) — see portable series.
notes.ur: Portable E4 ka matlab alag hai (display aur main PCB ke darmiyan link) — portable series dekhein.

title.ur: AC par zyada current se protection (overcurrent protection)

meaning.en: Running current exceeded the allowed limit; inverter/protection shuts down the unit.
meaning.ur: Chalte hue current ki hadd khatam ho gayi; protection system unit band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Unstable mains voltage or brown-out conditions.
causes.ur: Unstable voltage, voltage ki girawat ya kam voltage (brown-out).

causes.en: Compressor jam, shorted windings, or overloaded system.
causes.ur: Compressor jam hona, winding mein short, ya system par zyada load.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If the fault returns, contact an Authorised Service Center; check supply voltage.
solutions.ur: Agar fault dobara aaye to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein aur supply voltage check karein.

notes.en: PK YouTube shorts also reference E5 (video-title confidence only).
notes.ur: PK YouTube shorts mein bhi E5 ka zikr hai (confidence sirf video-title tak hai).

title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit ki aarpaar communication kharabi

meaning.en: Signal wire or protocol link between indoor and outdoor boards is broken.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor board ke darmiyan signal wire ya link (protocol) toot gaya hai.

causes.en: Loose, burnt, or incorrectly wired interconnect cable.
causes.ur: Interconnect wire dhili ho gayi, jal gayi ya ghalat wiring ki gayi ho.

causes.en: Outdoor board power fault or Earth leakage tripping the link.
causes.ur: Outdoor board ki supply kharab hona ya earth leakage se link tootna.

solutions.en: Contact an Authorised Service Center (official IE solution — no DIY restart advised).
solutions.ur: Authorised Service Center se rabta karein (official hal mein khud karke dobara start na karein).

solutions.en: Before the visit, power-cycle once and inspect the 2–4 pin interconnect for damage.
solutions.ur: Technician ke aane se pehle ek baar power cycle karein aur 2–4 conductor interconnect wire mein nuqsan dekh lein.

notes.en: PK video title-level corroboration (low confidence, separate video series).
notes.ur: PK video ke title se milta julta saboot hai (confidence low, video series alag hai).

meaning.en: A monitored temperature (often indoor heat-exchanger or module) exceeded the trip limit.
meaning.ur: Kisi monitor kiye gaye sensor (aksar indoor heat exchanger ya module) ka temperature trip hadd cross kar chuka hai.

causes.en: Blocked airflow across the indoor heat exchanger.
causes.ur: Indoor heat exchanger ke upar hawa ka rasta band hona.

causes.en: Fan failure or extremely high room temperature.
causes.ur: Fan kharab hona ya kamre ka temperature bilkul zyada hona.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

title.en: Protection code H4 (description missing on source)
title.ur: Protection code H4 (source par tafsil mojood nahin)

meaning.en: Official table lists H4 without a malfunction description (page layout gap).
meaning.ur: Official list mein H4 malfunction ki tafsil ke baghair hai (page layout ki kami).

causes.en: Source does not state causes for H4.
causes.ur: Source H4 ke asbab nahi batata.

causes.en: Treat as generic inverter/heating-related protection until a service manual confirms.
causes.ur: Service manual ki sakhiye tak ise aam inverter/heating protection samajhein.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again (pattern used for sibling codes on the same page).
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein (usi page ke doosre codes ka official tareeqa).

solutions.en: Contact an Authorised Service Center for the exact sub-code diagnosis.
solutions.ur: Durust diagnosis ke liye Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

notes.en: Layout artifact: H4 row has empty malfunction cell; solution text sits with H6 row.
notes.ur: Layout ki wajah se: H4 row ki malfunction cell khali hai, solution ka text H6 row ke saath pada hai.

title.en: No feedback from indoor fan motor
title.ur: Indoor fan motor se koi feedback nahi

meaning.en: Indoor fan motor is not reporting RPM/back-EMF to the board.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor board ko RPM/back-EMF (ohm) ki nishandi nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Fan motor connector loose or motor winding open.
causes.ur: Fan motor ka connector dhila hua ya motor ki winding khuli ho gayi ho.

causes.en: Blade jammed by dust/debris or failed indoor PCB driver.
causes.ur: Blade dust/debris se jam ya indoor board ka driver kharab.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

notes.en: Official text: 'No feedback from indoor fan motor' sits on the H6 row.
notes.ur: Official text: 'No feedback from indoor fan motor' — yeh H6 row par likha hai.

title.ur: Jumper cap ki kharabi se protection

meaning.en: Configuration jumper/cap on the indoor board is missing or detected wrong.
meaning.ur: Indoor board par configuration jumper/cap ghaayab ya ghalat detect hua.

causes.en: Jumper cap not fitted after board replacement or shipping.
causes.ur: Board ki tabdeeli ya shipping ke baad jumper cap nahi lagaya gaya.

causes.en: Oxidized or broken jumper contacts.
causes.ur: Jumper ke contact zang lage ya toote hue.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center (fit correct jumper).
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein (sahi jumper lagayein).

title.en: Indoor and outdoor units do not match
title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor units match nahi karte

meaning.en: Pairing check failed — capacity/model IDs of the two units disagree.
meaning.ur: Pairing ki check nakaam — dono units ki capacity/model ID mein mismatch hai.

causes.en: Wrong outdoor unit matched during installation.
causes.ur: Installation mein ghalat outdoor unit jor di gayi.

causes.en: Board swapped with a different capacity firmware set.
causes.ur: Kisi aur capacity ke firmware set wala board laga diya gaya.

solutions.en: Contact the dealer for the appliance (official IE guidance).
solutions.ur: Appliance ke dealer se rabta karein (official guidance).

solutions.en: Verify indoor/outdoor model and capacity labels before re-pairing.
solutions.ur: Dobara pair karne se pehle indoor/outdoor ke model aur capacity ke label check karein.

title.ur: Outdoor DC fan motor mein kharabi

meaning.en: Outdoor fan motor feedback is abnormal (stall, open winding, or driver fault).
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan motor ka feedback abnormal hai (jam, winding khuli ya driver kharabi).

causes.en: Outdoor fan motor seized by dirt or bearing failure.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor gand se jam ya bearing kharab.

causes.en: Motor connector corrosion or ODU PCB driver failure.
causes.ur: Connector par zang lagne se ya outdoor board ka driver kharab hona.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

notes.en: Portable L3 = condenser DC fan failed (UK article) — related but portable-scoped.
notes.ur: Portable L3 = condenser DC fan kharab (UK article) — milta julta hai lekin sirf portable tak mehdood hai.

meaning.en: Compressor/system current limit hit; unit stops to protect the drive.
meaning.ur: Compressor/system current ki hadd poori ho gayi; drive ki protection ke liye unit ruk jata hai.

causes.en: Mechanical overload on the compressor at startup.
causes.ur: Startup par compressor par mechanical load.

causes.en: Low supply voltage causing high running current.
causes.ur: Supply voltage kam hone se chalte hue current zyada hona.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Excess refrigerant or oil trapping is indicated in the circuit.
meaning.ur: Circuit mein zyada refrigerant ya tel phanse ki nishandi.

causes.en: Overcharge during gas top-up.
causes.ur: Gas bharte waqt zyada charge.

causes.en: Liquid slugging risk after improper vacuum/charging.
causes.ur: Galat vacuum/charging ke baad liquid slugging ka risk.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center for recovery/re-charge.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein recovery/re-charging ke liye.

meaning.en: Room-temperature thermistor reads open circuit or short circuit.
meaning.ur: Room temperature thermistor khuli circuit ya short par padh raha hai.

causes.en: Sensor plug disconnected from the indoor board.
causes.ur: Sensor plug indoor board se nikla hua.

causes.en: Thermistor wire broken inside insulation or sensor itself failed.
causes.ur: Thermistor ki wire insulation ke andar se tooti ya sensor kharab.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center (check/replacement).
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein (check/tabdeeli karwayein).

notes.en: PK YouTube title also mentions F1 inverter fix (low confidence, separate series).
notes.ur: PK YouTube title mein F1 inverter fix ka bhi zikr hai (confidence low, series alag hai).

meaning.en: Evaporator pipe thermistor is open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Evaporator pipe ka thermistor khuli ya short hai.

causes.en: Sensor not inserted properly in the coil holder.
causes.ur: Sensor coil holder mein theek se nahi lagaya gaya.

causes.en: Wiring harness chafed during installation.
causes.ur: Installation ke doran wiring harness ragad/marr gaya.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Outdoor air-temperature thermistor is open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Bahar ki hawa temperature wala thermistor khuli ya short hai.

causes.en: Sensor wire chewed by rodents or corroded at the ODU connector.
causes.ur: Sensor wire chuhiye ke katne se ya connector par zang lagne se kharab.

causes.en: Thermistor failure after water ingress in the outdoor box.
causes.ur: Outdoor box mein paani jaane se thermistor kharab.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Condenser pipe thermistor is open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Condenser pipe ka thermistor khuli ya short hai.

causes.en: Sensor clip loose on the discharge/liquid line.
causes.ur: Sensor clip discharge/liquid line par dhila hua.

causes.en: Open or shorted sensor element.
causes.ur: Sensor ka element khuli ya short circuit mein.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Compressor discharge-temperature thermistor is open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Compressor discharge temperature thermistor khuli ya short hai.

causes.en: Sensor wire melted near hot discharge pipe.
causes.ur: Garam discharge pipe ke paas sensor wire pighal gaya.

causes.en: Thermistor failure or connector not seated.
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab ya connector theek se baitha hua nahi.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

meaning.en: System overload detected; controller lowers compressor frequency.
meaning.ur: System par zyada load mila, controller compressor ki frequency kam kar deta hai.

causes.en: High ambient with dirty condenser reducing capacity.
causes.ur: Ganda condenser aur zyada ambient temperature se capacity kam hona.

causes.en: Undercharged refrigerant raising discharge pressure.
causes.ur: Refrigerant kam hone se discharge pressure high hona.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

notes.ur: Source ka label: 'Overload limit/fall frequency' — yehi lafz source mein istemal hua hai.

meaning.en: Drive current above limit; compressor frequency is stepped down.
meaning.ur: Drive current hadd se zyada hai; compressor ki frequency kam ki jati hai.

causes.en: Weak mains or long cable voltage drop.
causes.ur: Kamzor supply ya lambi cable ki wajah se voltage drop.

causes.en: Inverter module or compressor winding degradation.
causes.ur: Inverter module ya compressor ki winding kamzor hona.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

title.en: High discharge temperature limit / frequency reduction
title.ur: Discharge temperature ki hadd par frequency ki kami

meaning.en: Discharge temp near trip point; frequency reduced to cool the compressor.
meaning.ur: Discharge temperature trip ke qareeb hai; compressor ko thanda karne ke liye frequency kam ki jati hai.

causes.en: Low refrigerant or restricted condenser.
causes.ur: Refrigerant kam ya condenser mein rukaawat.

causes.en: Poor outdoor fan performance.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan ki performance kamzor.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

title.ur: Antifreeze hadd par frequency ki kami

meaning.en: Heating-mode anti-freeze threshold approached; compressor slows.
meaning.ur: Heating mode mein pani jamne ki hadd ke qareeb compressor dheema ho jata hai.

causes.en: Low airflow over indoor coil during heating.
causes.ur: Heating mein coil par kam hawa.

causes.en: Dirty filter or blocked louvers.
causes.ur: Ganda filter ya band louvers.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center; clean filter first.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein; pehle filter saaf karein.

meaning.en: Normal reverse-cycle defrost in heat mode — not a failure.
meaning.ur: Heating mode mein yeh aam reverse-cycle defrost hai — kharabi nahi.

causes.en: Outdoor coil frosting in heating operation (normal).
causes.ur: Heating ke doran outdoor coil par barf jana aam baat hai.

causes.en: Low ambient with high humidity accelerating frost.
causes.ur: Kam temperature aur zyada humidity se tez barf banna.

solutions.en: Wait — unit resumes heating automatically after defrost.
solutions.ur: Intezaar karein — defrost ke baad unit khud heating shuru kar deti hai.

solutions.en: No service call needed unless defrost never ends or icing persists in cooling.
solutions.ur: Jab tak defrost khatam na ho ya cooling mein barf jata rahe, service call ki zaroorat nahi.

notes.ur: Official: 'This indicates routine defrosting.' — is ka matlab hai ke unit waqta waqt defrost kar rahi hai.

meaning.en: Compressor overload trip — unit stops to prevent winding damage.
meaning.ur: Compressor overload trip — winding ki protection ke liye unit ruk jata hai.

causes.en: Seized compressor or high head pressure.
causes.ur: Compressor jam hona ya zyada head pressure.

causes.en: Overcharge, non-condensables, or weak capacitor.
causes.ur: Zyada charge, non-condensing gas, ya kamzor capacitor.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Intelligent Power Module fault/over-temperature in the outdoor inverter.
meaning.ur: Outdoor inverter ke power module mein kharabi ya zyada hararat

causes.en: IPM overheat from blocked ODU airflow or failed fan.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ki hawa block ho gayi ya fan kharab hone se IPM garam ho gaya

causes.en: Short on compressor windings or damaged module.
causes.ur: Compressor ki winding mein short ya module kharab.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: Otherwise, request a visit by an installation technician (official wording).
solutions.ur: Warna installation technician ki visit maangein (official alfaz).

meaning.en: Power-factor-correction stage fault in the inverter input.
meaning.ur: Inverter input mein power factor correction (PFC) stage ki kharabi.

causes.en: Mains surge damaged PFC components.
causes.ur: Mains surge ne PFC ke components kharab kiye.

causes.en: Reactor/inductor or PFC controller failure.
causes.ur: Reactor/inductor ya PFC controller kharab.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Controller cannot read stored configuration from EEPROM.
meaning.ur: Controller EEPROM se mehfooz configuration nahi parh sakta.

causes.en: EEPROM chip or solder joint failure after power surge.
causes.ur: Surge ke baad EEPROM chip ya solder joint kharab.

causes.en: Corrupted parameter write during voltage dip.
causes.ur: Voltage drop ke doran parameter ka data corrupt hona.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: Otherwise, request a visit by an installation technician (official wording).
solutions.ur: Warna installation technician ki visit maangein (official alfaz).

meaning.en: DC bus / line voltage above maximum allowed.
meaning.ur: DC bus / line voltage maximum se zyada hai.

causes.en: Mains overvoltage or wrong supply rating connected.
causes.ur: Mains overvoltage ya galat supply rating.

causes.en: Grid surge without adequate protection.
causes.ur: Adequate protection ke baghair grid surge.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center; verify supply.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein aur supply check karein.

meaning.en: DC bus / line voltage below minimum allowed (brown-out).
meaning.ur: DC bus / line voltage minimum hadd se neeche (kam voltage, brown-out).

causes.en: Utility brown-out or long wire voltage drop.
causes.ur: Utility brown-out ya lambi wire se voltage drop.

causes.en: Loose supply terminals.
causes.ur: Supply terminals dhile.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center; check input voltage.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein aur input voltage check karein.

meaning.en: Reversing (4-way) valve position feedback is abnormal in heat-pump mode.
meaning.ur: Heat pump mode mein reversing (4-way) valve ki position feedback abnormal hai.

causes.en: Valve coil open or solenoid stuck.
causes.ur: Valve coil khuli ya solenoid jam.

causes.en: Coil not energized due to wiring/relay fault.
causes.ur: Wiring/relay kharabi se coil ko current nahi mil raha.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Test-mode indicator for minimum compressor frequency — not a field fault.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki minimum frequency ka test mode indicator — yeh field kharabi nahi hai.

causes.en: Unit entered service/test mode.
causes.ur: Unit service/test mode mein chala gaya.

causes.en: Remote/controller command set test frequency.
causes.ur: Remote/controller ne test frequency set ki.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again to leave test mode.
solutions.ur: Test mode se bahar aane ke liye appliance band karke dobara on karein.

solutions.en: If it reappears in normal use, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar aam istemal mein dobara aaye to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

notes.en: Official: 'Min. frequency for compressor in test mode'.
notes.ur: Official: 'Min. frequency for compressor in test mode' — yani test mode mein compressor ki sabse kam frequency.

meaning.en: Test-mode indicator for rated compressor frequency — split context.
meaning.ur: Rated compressor frequency ka test mode indicator — split context.

causes.en: Service/test mode active on split unit.
causes.ur: Split unit par source/test mode faal.

causes.en: Not to be confused with portable P1 (full tray).
causes.ur: Portable P1 (poori tray bharna) ke saath mila kar na dein.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: For portable units, drain the tray instead (see portable series).
solutions.ur: Portable unit ke liye tarike se tray khaali karein (portable series dekhein).

notes.en: Collision: portable P1 = full bottom tray (different product).
notes.ur: Collision: portable P1 = bottom tray bhara hua (product alag hai).

meaning.en: Test-mode indicator for maximum compressor frequency.
meaning.ur: Maximum compressor frequency ka test mode indicator.

causes.en: Service/test mode active.
causes.ur: Service/test mode faal.

causes.en: Factory or technician frequency cap test.
causes.ur: Factory ya technician ki frequency test.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If it persists in normal operation, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar aam kaam mein jari rahe to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Test-mode indicator for medium compressor frequency.
meaning.ur: Medium compressor frequency ka test mode indicator.

causes.en: Service/test mode active.
causes.ur: Service/test mode faal.

causes.en: Technician stepping frequency during diagnosis.
causes.ur: Diagnosis ke doran technician frequency badal raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If it persists in normal operation, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar aam kaam mein jari rahe to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Compressor frequency capped because of power/energy limit.
meaning.ur: Power/energy limit ki hadd ki wajah se compressor ki frequency limit kar di gayi hai (capped).

causes.en: Low supply capability or temporary grid constraint.
causes.ur: Supply ki capability kam ya grid ki aarzi pabandi.

causes.en: Anti-short-cycle or power-managed soft limit.
causes.ur: Power managed soft limit (anti-short-cycle).

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again.
solutions.ur: Appliance band karke dobara on karein

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

meaning.en: Compressor frequency capped because the power module is too hot.
meaning.ur: Power module bohat garam hone ki wajah se compressor ki frequency limit kar di gayi hai.

causes.en: ODU heatsink blocked or ambient extremely hot.
causes.ur: Outdoor heat sink band hona ya ambient bohat zyada garm.

causes.en: Weak cooling on module heatsink / fan fault.
causes.ur: Module heat sink ki cooling kamzor ya fan kharab.

solutions.en: Switch the appliance off and on again after clearing ODU airflow.
solutions.ur: Outdoor ki hawa saaf kar ke appliance band/on karein.

solutions.en: If unresolved, contact an Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Agar hal nahi hota to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.
